featureModel.description: A model id, or "default" to reset to the curated default.

description: User-level Command Code preferences (~/.commandcode/config.json). Command Code writes this file itself as you use the CLI; the keys below mirror the CLI configuration registry. Docs: https://commandcode.ai/docs/settings

$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON Schema.

autoInstallExtension.description: Auto-install the IDE extension on startup.

branchSummarySkipPrompt.description: Never ask about summarizing when switching branches in /tree.

codemode.description: Scope of the codemode tool (MCP only, read-only + MCP tools, or off).

collapsePastedText.description: Collapse long pasted/dictated text (over 300 chars) into a [first words... +NL] token.

compactMode.description: Auto-compact aggressiveness when context fills up.

defaultExportFormat.description: Format a bare /export (no format or path) writes.

defaultShareGistFormat.description: Format a bare /share gist (no format argument) posts.

featureModels.description: Model overrides for background features and the planning/implementation lanes. A model id, or "default" to follow the curated default. Unknown/future feature keys are allowed.

imageVisionEnabled.description: Let a text-only model read attached images by describing them with the vision model. true = enabled, false = disabled; omit the key for "ask" (prompt on first use), which is the default.

model.description: Default model id for new sessions. A running session keeps its current model.

onDemandToolDescriptions.description: Explain shell commands on permission prompts only when you press ctrl+e.

peekRecapDelayMinutes.description: Recap a finished task only after this many minutes passed since your last message. The CLI writes either a number or a numeric string.

peekRecapDiagram.description: Draw a short text diagram recapping a task that changed files or ran commands.

reasoningEffort.description: Per-model reasoning effort, keyed by model id.

showTasteLearningInFeed.description: Show Taste learning notices in the conversation feed.

theme.description: Terminal color theme. Auto detects your terminal background.

title: Command Code config.json
